items.title: Stuart Bergen Interview, 1970-07-18
items.q: I don't know his real name, but he was a kid. He'd always, usually brighten up my day when he'd come in... It was Abbey Brunis, the drum player's brother.

ctx.x: I don't know his real name, but he was a kid. He'd always, usually brighten up my day when he'd come in, because as soon as he'd come in he'd hit on a desk. Let's have it. Da da da da da da da da da. That's the way he was.
Well, that was Henry was that guy, wasn't it? No, I remember.
It was Abbey Brunis, the drum player's brother. Yeah. I can't, we called him Monk. I remember him. We called him Monk. He had a big chin.
